Company: Vintage Web Media
Position: Web Maintenance Intern
Location: Chicago, IL
Duration: 8 months co-op program

Overview:
Vintage Web Media manages and maintains content delivery portals and legacy web properties for regional publishing clients. We are looking for a dedicated intern for an extended 8-month co-op placement to assist our digital operations department.

Day-to-day Responsibilities:
• Maintain and patch legacy server scripts written in PHP and jQuery across dozens of client blogs.
• Update layout CSS stylesheets and HTML content templates for weekly editorial releases.
• Troubleshoot FTP deployments and maintain Apache web server configuration files.
• Assist client support staff with minor bug fixes and database backup verifications.

Candidate Profile & Experience:
• Familiarity with PHP, jQuery, CSS, and HTML web fundamentals.
• Willingness to commit to a full 8-month consecutive duration schedule in our downtown Chicago office.
• Strong written communication and troubleshooting skills for resolving client issue tickets.
• Basic understanding of web servers and domain administration.
